verdict.rationale: Supabase documents an AI Assistant built into the Dashboard. It generates SQL queries from your specifications, analyzes errors in your SQL code and suggests fixes, and gives context-specific feedback while you work on a table. It can also generate and deploy Edge Functions. Evidence for the 'explain my backend' part is thin: it covers schema-design guidance and table-level feedback, not explaining the backend as a whole. Debugging is documented only for SQL errors. missing for 10: documented explanation of the overall backend (auth, functions, policies), debugging beyond SQL errors (e.g. logs or runtime errors), independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard assistant.
